input.text:
I fired my best salesperson.

Not because she missed targets. She beat them every quarter.

I let her go because every new hire who sat next to her quit within six months. She closed deals by hoarding leads and belittling colleagues, and I'd been too dazzled by her numbers to see it.

The year after she left, team revenue went up 30%. Not because anyone replaced her, but because eleven people stopped being afraid.

Your top performer might be your biggest bottleneck. Who's the brilliant person on your team that nobody dares to challenge?
